summary: The root ضوأ (DwA) in form V, تضوّأ, describes someone standing in darkness to observe others by the light of their fire, without being seen themselves.
lane: 5 تضوّأ ذ He stood in the dark to see people by the light of their fire, (AZ, K, TA,) without their seeing him. (AZ, TA.) And تضوّا ٱمْرَأَةً [ He stood in the dark to see a woman by the light of her fire, without her seeing him ]. (TA.)
